zone.label: C(6)
zone.source: OZP ZONE layer, point-in-polygon at model centre
zone.note: The model bbox straddles a C(6) zone and the MRDJ (Major Road and Junction) reservation: a 60×60 grid over the footprint lands 63.1% inside C(6) and 36.9% inside MRDJ.

height.note: Height control is not uniform across the footprint: 110 m covers 55.2% of the grid, 130 m covers 7.8%, and 36.9% (the road reservation) carries no BHC row at all — a single-number answer would be wrong here.

model_top.note: Levels are named by absolute mPD, so the roof plant room sits ~63.3 mPD — 5.8 m above the surveyed ground surface, not a 63 m tower.
